name: DeadSouls-FluffOS2019
english_description: The fluffos GitHub org's own maintained fork of the classic Dead Souls 3.8.6 LPC mudlib library/tutorial, pre-adapted for modern FluffOS (targets the v2019 driver branch as a git submodule) rather than a legacy archive dump -- a separate, independently-sourced snapshot from this collection's other Dead Souls entry (ds386, converted from an unrelated standalone legacy archive), kept as a distinct slug per this project's convention for meaningfully different sources of the same underlying codebase.
